title: Vandenberg and Malmstrom as recurring UFO hotspots
place_text: Vandenberg AFB, California; Malmstrom AFB, Montana

tellings.quote: It's one of these places like Malmstrom uh you know base in Montana where throughout the years you have recurring patterns of UFO sightings.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Vandenberg, a military base in California used for rocket and missile launches, is one of a handful of places where UFO sightings keep happening over the years. He puts it alongside Malmstrom, an Air Force base in Montana that guards nuclear missiles. If true, it would suggest that whatever people are seeing takes a steady interest in these military sites.
